In business, smartphone usage restrictions at events and schools are being debated (BBC Business), UK defence spending could be accelerated through war bonds (BBC Business), and weight-loss jabs are influencing consumer behavior (BBC Business). Other notable stories include the shooting of an intensive care nurse in Minneapolis (BBC World) and the capture of a suspected Russian tanker captain by French authorities (BBC World). Former US President Trump praised UK soldiers in Afghanistan, calling them 'among greatest of all warriors' (BBC World).
